# Magician's Legendary Items Resource Pack
This is the resource pack for The [Magician's Legendary Items](https://modrinth.com/datapack/magicians-legendary-items) Data Pack. This resource pack dose nothing on it own.

**IMPORTANT**

**This resource pack requires [this](https://modrinth.com/datapack/magicians-legendary-items) data pack to work correctly, make sure they are both installed!**
